titles.title: En Zayıf Uyanmış, Balçık Sentezleyerek Yükseliyor
The Ultimate Farmer With Slime Fusion
The Weakest Awakened Rises Through Slime Synthesis
The Weakest Awakened Rises to the Top by Fusing Slimes
Thức Tỉnh Giả Yếu Nhất Trở Thành Bá Chủ Nhờ Dung Hợp Slime
最弱覚醒者はスライム合成で成り上がる

description:
For years, Saku Kamishiro has lived at the absolute bottom of the awakened food chain. Unable to clear quests or gain even a single level, the struggling young adventurer has been trapped in a grueling, dead-end life of poverty and ridicule.

Then, disaster and opportunity collide when he stumbles headfirst into a sudden “Dungeon Alteration.”

Desperate to shatter the status quo and stake his life on one last gamble, Saku plunges deep into the mutating labyrinth. There, a miraculous secondary awakening takes hold, granting him an absurd, seemingly useless power: the ability of the
“Slime Road.”

Far from being helpless, Saku discovers the true, game-changing potential of his new title. Utilizing his unique slime-based skills and an army of remarkably obedient, versatile slimes, Saku completely abandons traditional raiding and decides to do something unprecedented: he starts a farm inside the dungeon.

Before long, the magical crops, high-yield elixirs, and peerless dungeon-bred items he cultivates generate otherworldly value, drawing the attention of wealthy merchants, powerful factions, and a growing community of quirky, lovable monsters who gather at his doorstep.

From the weakest outcast in history to an unstoppable agricultural tycoon—Saku’s relaxed, unbeatably overpowered dungeon slow-life begins now!
